title: Working With a Trusted Advisor
author: Admired Leadership
summary: This essay makes the case for executive coaching by pointing to how universal it has become among elite performers -- citing statistics on Fortune 500 and startup CEOs who work with a trusted advisor. Its core argument is that the more successful a leader becomes, the harder it is to get unfiltered, candid feedback from people who benefit from that leader's success, which makes an independent advisor uniquely valuable. It describes what good advisors provide: a mirror for self-awareness, pattern recognition from having seen many similar situations, and a commitment to stay outside the leader's inner circle so their candor never gets diluted. A Tom Landry quote anchors the piece's closing argument.
points: More than half of Fortune 500 CEOs, and over 80 percent of startup CEOs, work with a trusted advisor or executive coach.
As leaders become more successful, candid feedback from people around them becomes harder to get because their advice gets filtered.
Good advisors act as a mirror, helping leaders see their strengths and blemishes clearly -- 'no matter how talented the surgeon, they can't operate on themselves.'
The best advisors bring pattern recognition from having seen many other leaders face similar problems.
A trusted advisor must stay outside the leader's inner circle to avoid diluting their candor over time.
quotes: More than 50 percent of the CEOs in Fortune 500 companies work with a trusted advisor or executive coach.
The more accomplished and successful a leader or performer becomes, the harder it is to attain candid feedback and advice from those who benefit from their success.
The best advisors hold up a mirror and allow leaders to see themselves with all of their strengths and blemishes.
The key is to find someone who you can trust completely, who will tell you the candid truth about you and your team, and never assimilate by becoming an insider or colleague.
A coach is someone who tells you what you don't want to hear, who has you see what you don't want to see, so you can be who you have always known you could be.
They carry the unbridled truth in a perfectly approachable way.
